user.title: Weather sources and site
user.description: Pick the weather station sensors used for the FAO-56 daily calculation. They need a unit and a state class (they are read from Home Assistant's long-term statistics). Add zones afterwards from the integration page.

data_description.rain_entity: A rain total sensor (state class total or total increasing), e.g. the station's daily rain.
data_description.pressure_entity: If omitted, pressure is estimated from elevation (FAO-56 eq. 7).
data_description.anemometer_height_m: Height of the wind sensor above the ground: wind is converted to 2 m (FAO-56 eq. 47).

data_description.rain_entity: A rain total sensor (state class total or total increasing), e.g. the station's daily rain.
data_description.pressure_entity: If omitted, pressure is estimated from elevation (FAO-56 eq. 7).
data_description.anemometer_height_m: Height of the wind sensor above the ground: wind is converted to 2 m (FAO-56 eq. 47).

error.wrong_unit: Unsupported or missing unit of measurement.
error.wrong_state_class: The sensor has no suitable state class, so Home Assistant keeps no statistics for it.
error.not_numeric: The sensor state is not numeric.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Garden Irrigation is already configured. Add zones from the integration page.

user.title: Irrigation zone
user.description: Agronomic data of the zone. Water amounts and liters are estimates.

data_description.awc_mm_per_m: Leave empty to use the soil type value (FAO-56 Table 19). Required for a custom soil.
data_description.max_block_mm: Most water a single block should apply before a soak pause. Leave empty to use the soil type value. Required for a custom soil.
data_description.depletion_fraction: Fraction of the available water that can be used before the lawn is stressed (FAO-56 Table 22: 0.40 for cool-season turf).
data_description.rate_mains_mm_per_min: Millimeters per minute measured with a catch-cup test using this source. Leave empty if this zone is never watered from it.
data_description.rate_tank_mm_per_min: Millimeters per minute measured with a catch-cup test using this source. Leave empty if this zone is never watered from it.
data_description.soil_moisture_entity: Device-relative reading, not volumetric water content. Used only as a soft confirmation.
data_description.soil_moisture_dry: Your own threshold, read from the sensor's history (see the documentation).
data_description.soil_moisture_wet: Your own threshold, read from the sensor's history (see the documentation).

kc.title: Custom monthly Kc
kc.description: Crop coefficient for each month (FAO-56 single Kc).

error.wrong_unit: Unsupported or missing unit of measurement.
error.wrong_state_class: The sensor has no suitable state class, so Home Assistant keeps no statistics for it.
error.not_numeric: The sensor state is not numeric.
error.name_exists: A zone with this name already exists.
error.required_for_custom_soil: Required when the soil type is custom.
error.no_rate: Enter the application rate of at least one water source.
error.thresholds_without_sensor: Thresholds need a soil moisture sensor.

data_description.rain_effective_factor: Share of the rain that counts towards the soil (0–1).
data_description.rain_threshold_mm: Daily rain below this value is ignored.
data_description.daily_run_time: When the previous day is finalized and the recommendation is updated.
data_description.hargreaves_fallback: If solar radiation or wind are missing, estimate ET0 with Hargreaves (less accurate, flagged as estimate).
data_description.forecast_entity: Informational only: forecast rain is shown next to the recommendation, it never changes it.
data_description.weekly_cap_mm: Warn when recorded irrigation in the last 7 days exceeds this value. Leave empty to disable.

source_incomplete.title: Weather source with missing data
source_incomplete.description: The sensor `{entity_id}` has statistics for only {hours} of 24 hours on {day}, so that day was marked incomplete. Check that the sensor is reporting and that the recorder keeps its statistics (it needs a state class).

record_irrigation.name: Record irrigation
record_irrigation.description: Record an irrigation you just did on a zone (timestamp: now). Give either the minutes or the millimeters.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long you watered. Converted to mm with the zone's application rate for this source (estimate).

mm.name: Millimeters
mm.description: Water applied, if you know it directly.

set_deficit.name: Set deficit
set_deficit.description: Set the current soil water deficit of a zone, e.g. 0 the day after a soaking rain.

deficit_mm.name: Deficit
deficit_mm.description: Water missing to field capacity right now (0 = field capacity). At most the zone's TAW.

invalid_zone.message: The selected device is not a Garden Irrigation zone.

minutes_or_mm.message: Give either the minutes or the millimeters, not both.

source_rate_missing.message: Zone {zone} has no application rate for source {source}: give the millimeters instead, or set the rate in the zone settings.

deficit_above_taw.message: The deficit cannot exceed the zone's total available water ({taw} mm).
